plain_text:
1 in 3 adults ages 45 and older
feel lonely, and 1 in 4 ages 65
and older are socially isolated.

plain_text:
SOURCE: National Academies of Sciences,
Engineering, and Medicine
semantic_text: SOURCE: National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine

plain_text:
Have you ever felt lonely in a busy supermarket or a
crowded party? While we all feel lonely sometimes, social
ties are important for everyone. Strong connections are
particularly important for the health and well-being of older
adults.
semantic_text: Have you ever felt lonely in a busy supermarket or a crowded party? While we all feel lonely sometimes, social ties are important for everyone. Strong connections are particularly important for the health and well-being of older adults.

plain_text:
Loneliness and social isolation aren't the same thing, but
they are related. Loneliness is a feeling of emotional pain
about being alone or separated from other people (even
if we're not physically alone). Social isolation results from
not having many social contacts or people to interact with,
which can lead to feeling very lonely.
semantic_text: Loneliness and social isolation aren't the same thing, but they are related. Loneliness is a feeling of emotional pain about being alone or separated from other people (even if we're not physically alone). Social isolation results from not having many social contacts or people to interact with, which can lead to feeling very lonely.

plain_text:
As people age, they often find themselves spending more
time alone. Certain things can put older adults at a higher
risk for social isolation and loneliness. These include living
alone, having limited mobility or no reliable way to get
around, financial struggles, language barriers, and caregiving
duties. Physical distancing during the COVID-19 pandemic
also made it harder to see family and friends in person.
semantic_text: As people age, they often find themselves spending more time alone. Certain things can put older adults at a higher risk for social isolation and loneliness. These include living alone, having limited mobility or no reliable way to get around, financial struggles, language barriers, and caregiving duties. Physical distancing during the COVID-19 pandemic also made it harder to see family and friends in person.

plain_text:
■ Checking in regularly with family and friends via
phone, email, or video chat
■ Meeting other people with shared interests
■ Trying a new activity or revisiting an old hobby
■ Getting involved in the community
semantic_text: ■ Checking in regularly with family and friends via phone, email, or video chat ■ Meeting other people with shared interests ■ Trying a new activity or revisiting an old hobby ■ Getting involved in the community

plain_text:
One in four adults ages 65 and older are socially isolated,
and research shows that this can take a toll on overall
health and well-being. Loneliness and social isolation have
been linked to conditions such as heart disease, high blood
pressure, anxiety, depression, and cognitive decline.
semantic_text: One in four adults ages 65 and older are socially isolated, and research shows that this can take a toll on overall health and well-being. Loneliness and social isolation have been linked to conditions such as heart disease, high blood pressure, anxiety, depression, and cognitive decline.

plain_text:
To address this challenge, the National Institute on Aging
(NIA) has tips to help older adults stay connected.
semantic_text:
To address this challenge, the National Institute on Aging
(NIA) has tips to help older adults stay connected.

plain_text:
Check out NIA's Loneliness and Social Isolation—Tips
for Staying Connected (also available in Spanish) for more
information and resources to help you and your loved ones
stay in touch.
semantic_text: Check out NIA's Loneliness and Social Isolation—Tips for Staying Connected (also available in Spanish) for more information and resources to help you and your loved ones stay in touch.

plain_text:
You can also spread the word online with NIA's Social
Isolation and Loneliness Outreach Toolkit.
semantic_text: You can also spread the word online with NIA's Social Isolation and Loneliness Outreach Toolkit.

plain_text:
With these tools and resources at your fingertips, you
can join the fight against loneliness and social isolation and
support older adults in your family, community, and beyond
in building and maintaining strong social connections.
semantic_text: With these tools and resources at your fingertips, you can join the fight against loneliness and social isolation and support older adults in your family, community, and beyond in building and maintaining strong social connections.
